conbody.p: Jekyll is a classic Ruby-based SSG, originally the engine behind GitHub Pages. It converts Markdown (or other markup) into static sites using Liquid templates. It’s blog-aware by default but is widely used for documentation. Jekyll expects YAML front matter at the top of each page/post, with keys like title, layout, date, etc.
